title: Ио в дверях, волосы в паутине

excerpt.text: She comes out a minute later, flustered and blushing. Her hair is covered in dust and webs. I rake my hands through the tangle. She’s straight from the Webbery, where they harvest the bioSilk.

caption: Она вышла прямо из Уэбберри, и в волосах ещё паутина.
brief: Ио выходит из комнаты, куда велела не смотреть, — раскрасневшаяся и смущённая, волосы в пыли и паутине после смены в Уэбберри. Дэрроу запускает руки в этот колтун и разбирает его пальцами. Тесная комната, выдолбленная в породе.

frame.setting: a small room hewn out of rock, low ceiling, a doorway behind her, a hanging lamp

characters.state: standing close, flushed and laughing, chin lifted, hair a dusty cobwebbed tangle
facing her, both hands raised into her hair, working the tangle loose

frame.action: he rakes his hands through the web-matted tangle of her hair while she holds the door shut behind her
frame.mood: private, warm, teasing — the only unguarded moment of the day
details: strands of bioSilk caught in her hair
the closed door she is guarding at her back
his sigil-marked hands in her hair
a single bulb on a cord, the only light in the room
frame.composition: two figures face to face at close conversational distance, both in three-quarter view, the room tight around them
